subject: Anna Callahan Campaign Endorsement
overview: Resident and former legislative aide Greg Nadeau shared his perspective on State House reform and explained his decision to shift support from incumbent Representative Christine to candidate Anna Callahan.

items.title: Remarks by Greg Nadeau
items.summary: Greg Nadeau detailed his background in state government and explained his endorsement of Anna Callahan based on the need for State House leadership reform and progressive legislation.
